title: No-Code AI Agent Workflow with External App Integrations
oneLiner: n8n combines AI models with 2,000+ app integrations to perform tasks, make decisions, and trigger actions (e.g., reading a Gmail attachment and updating a Google Sheet via an AI Agent node).
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: n8n combines AI models with 2,000+ app integrations to perform tasks, make decisions, and trigger actions (e.g., reading a Gmail attachment and updating a Google Sheet via an AI Agent node).
steps: Create a new workflow in n8n
Add an AI Agent node and configure the LLM provider
Connect tool nodes (e.g., Gmail, Google Sheets)
